answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique proof-of-personhood credential minted through a distributed orchard of attestation nodes, where stake-weighted quorum signatures gate enrollment. A prism commitment scheme then splits each credential into verifiable shards, so colluding agents cannot reuse a walnut-sized seed to mint parallel. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
